notes: Vanilla wowsims does not model an Arcane-specific preset (the fork's mage/apls/p1.apl.json is Fire, ui/mage/apls/forever_frost.apl.json is Frost), so this was built from Forever's own Arcane talent tree plus a community guide, not a direct port. Fix round 1: two of this guide's own lines are presently inert in this engine build and are kept anyway per the fix-round-1 controller ruling, so the file states the intended design and upgrades itself once the engine catches up -- (1) Arcane Blast (400574): sim/mage/talents.go says outright the package does not register this spell yet; (2) the Missile Barrage gate on Arcane Missiles (400589): no aura is ever created under that id, because this package's Arcane Missiles channel is not re-costed/re-timed for the proc (also noted in sim/mage/talents.go). Both lines cast nothing today -- `notes` on each says so -- and an unconditional Arcane Missiles cast is added at the bottom of the priority list as the engine-castable Era filler that keeps this rotation actually dealing damage in the meantime; Era Arcane (before Arcane Blast existed) was itself an Arcane Missiles-spam rotation, so this is not a downgrade in spirit, only in ceiling. Arcane Missiles' own top rank (25345, rank 8) is also excluded by an off-by-one in the engine's registration loop (sim/mage/arcane_missiles.go: `for rank := 1; rank < ArcaneMissilesRanks; rank++`, so rank 8 never registers); every Arcane Missiles reference here uses 10212 (rank 7), the highest rank the engine actually registers, with the missing rank 8 recorded as an engine follow-up. Arcane Power and Presence of Mind are both confirmed castable and are kept on cooldown, off the GCD-costing category, ahead of a specific nuke. Every rank named here (other than the two flagged inert conditions) is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/. Rotation-accuracy program diagnosis (2026-09-28), inert 1239696 and 400589: Arcane Blast (sim/mage/arcane_blast.go) and Missile Barrage (sim/mage/missile_barrage.go) are both fully implemented now -- the two per-line notes below already say so -- but every rank of Arcane Blast beyond rank 1 (1239696/1239697/1239699/1239700) and every one of Missile Barrage's proc ids (400588/400589/401736/467409) are absent from talents/mage.json's own ranks[].spell_id table, which only names rank 1 (400574) as 'the id this talent point grants'. The ladder harness's talent-zero-points exemption (talentSpellIDs) therefore only recognizes 400574 as talent-gated, not the ids above it in the same chain or the proc aura id, even though registerArcaneBlastSpell gates EVERY rank on the same single Talents.ArcaneBlast bool. At level 30 exactly (the first level Arcane Blast rank 2's own RequiredLevel(30) would let it register) the ladder's own truncated talent walk has not yet reached that node, so the engine correctly does not resolve 1239696 -- and by level 38 it has (the golden's own level-38 cast set shows spell:1239696=41.2, the dominant cast), so this is not a persistent engine bug, just a harness talent-chain-tracking gap that happens to land exactly on level 30's rung. Missile Barrage (400589) shows the identical shape at levels 10 and 20, clear by level 30. Fix round: 1239696 is not declared inert here after all -- the pinned engine resolves it fine once both the level and the talent are met (confirmed by the level-38+ rungs of the ladder, and inert would have wrongly told the level-60 zero-talent smoke test to expect it unresolved, which it is not, since spellranks.json alone -- ignoring the talent -- already treats a level-60 character as having every rank). Fixed instead in sim/request/ladder.go: expandTalentSpellIDs widens the harness's zero-points exemption from talents.json's single named id per node (400574 only) to every id spellranks.json's own 'Arcane Blast' rank grouping shares with it, so rank 2 (1239696) is recognized as gated by the same talent rank 1 is. 400589 (Missile Barrage) stays declared inert: it is a bare aura id with no ranked chain at all (spellranks.json's four rows are all rank 0), so there is no ability-name grouping for expandTalentSpellIDs to walk, and it is never referenced by a level-60 zero-talent smoke run either way (the smoke build's own Missile Barrage condition is untalented and silent, not warned). Rotation-accuracy program, wand-weaving addition (2026-09-28): Shoot (5019) is declared inert because this build's item table has no wand with required_level <= 10, so the level-10 rung equips nothing in the ranged slot and core.RegisterShootSpell never registers the spell there; it resolves and fires heavily at levels 20 and 30 (64.9 and 68.2 percent of top casts) before Arcane Blast's mana efficiency keeps this bare-gear character's mana comfortably above Shoot's 20 percent threshold for the rest of a 300-iteration run -- see the expected_idle entry below for why it goes quiet again from level 38 on, not a regression. Rotation search (2026-10-07, after the engine began charging Arcane Blast its client price of 15% base mana plus 175% per stack): a stack-gated pair of Blasts followed by a Frostbolt filler measured about 10% above the old unconditional Blast line; six stack/filler candidates were measured by hand (one to three Blasts, Missiles or Frostbolt filler) because the search's mutations cannot write a stack gate. Theorycraft audit fix (design/reviews/2026-10-31-theorycraft-audit/casters.md A1, A2, A4): the engine let one Missile Barrage proc give two free Arcane Missiles; with that fixed, the raid build takes Missile Barrage 2/2 in place of Wand Specialization 1/2 (about +10 percent), and Arcane Blast now stacks to 3 before the Frostbolt filler (about +4 percent more). Client 1.60.1.70707 (2026-10-31): Arcane Blast's cost ramp fell to +100% a stack with an 18 sec buff; the Blast line now keeps casting past 3 stacks while the mana bar is ahead of the fight and above 20%, about +10% at the raid band in that run and within error at the bare band. Sim-accuracy round 4 (design/reviews/2026-11-01-sim-audit-round4/casters.md): the Missile Barrage line casts Arcane Missiles rank 7 (10212); rank 8 (25345) is an Ahn'Qiraj book rank, not learnable in Phase 1. Guide rewrite (2026-11-02): a Frostbolt cast 2.5 s before the pull lands at it, and Presence of Mind is spent on a Frostbolt instead of the next Arcane Blast; together about +1.4% with raid buffs and +1.2% without.

engineering_notes.3: Missile Barrage (400589) is the talent proc the engine registers since 2026-09-28.
engineering_notes.4: The client rank chain is 400574..1239700 (levels 20/30/40/50/60 per spellranks.json); this file names the top rank and the level rewrite picks the learned one. The engine registers the chain since the accuracy program (engine-caster lane). Rotation-accuracy program correction (2026-09-28): this note previously said the 1239696..1239700 portion covers levels 40..60 -- spellranks.json actually puts rank 2 (1239696) at level 30, not 40; see the top-level notes' inert entry for the level-30 harness gap this produces.
engineering_notes.5: Uses rank 7 (10212), the top trainer rank. Rank 8 (25345) is Tome of Arcane Missiles VIII, an Ahn'Qiraj book (sim-accuracy round 4, casters), which the engine registers only with core.IncludeAQ.
engineering_notes.6: Sim-accuracy round 21 (design/reviews/2026-11-05-sim-audit-round21/mage.md A5): the two Presence of Mind lines are gated on spellIsKnown(18809), Pyroblast, not on Heating Up. The raid order takes Pyroblast at 54 and Heating Up at 57; at 54 and 56 (bare band 50, raid order, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001) the Presence of Mind Pyroblast beats the Presence of Mind Frostbolt by 0.6 to 0.75 percent. The leveling build never takes Pyroblast and keeps the Frostbolt; level 60 is unchanged.
engineering_notes.7: Sim-accuracy round 21 (design/reviews/2026-11-05-sim-audit-round21/mage.md X4): Evocation (12051) trains at 20 and the engine no longer registers it below that level; the ladder level-gates the line through idLearnLevelOverrides (sim/request/ladder.go) and sim/internal/spellranks' singleTierLevelOverrides, so it is not declared inert.
engineering_notes.8: Sim-accuracy round 23 (design/reviews/2026-11-05-sim-audit-round23/mage.md A1, guide-accuracy round 24 sims requested 3): on the raid order Presence of Mind goes to Arcane Wrath (talent at 31, 3.5 s, 6 s cooldown) from 32 until Pyroblast at 54, Frostbolt when it is on cooldown: +0.4 to +0.9% at 32, 40, 48 and 53, bare bands, 10,000 iterations, seeds 1 and 50001, both factions. The leveling order takes no Arcane Wrath, so the row never fires there (45 and 60 unchanged). Sim-accuracy 2026-11-12 (Arcane lane): the leveling build takes Arcane Wrath at 44 for the fourth rank of Incineration (+6.8% at 45, +5.3% at 48, +2.7 to +2.9% at 50, +1.6 to +2.0% at 53 and 55, +0.4 to +0.6% at 58, +0.4 to +1.0% at 60, both factions, 10,000 iterations; design/reviews/2026-11-12-sim-accuracy/arcane.md), so the row fires from 44 on the leveling build too.

expected_idle.reason: Once Arcane Blast is talented and learned (level 30+ on this build), its mana efficiency keeps this bare-gear character's mana comfortably above the 20 percent threshold core.RegisterShootSpell's Shoot line is gated on for the rest of a 300-iteration run, so it never fires from level 38 on. Not a defect: the level 20 and 30 rungs already show it firing heavily (64.9 and 68.2 percent of top casts) before Arcane Blast takes over.

sources.label: Wowhead Classic: Arcane Mage DPS Rotation, Cooldowns, and Abilities

priorityList.notes: Evocation when you are nearly dry and more than 30 seconds of the fight remain. It is an 8 second channel at +1500% mana regeneration on an 8 minute cooldown, so it comes once a fight: spend your mana gem from 28 and a mana potion first, and at 60 a Demonic Rune too. Inside the last 30 seconds the mana comes back too late to spend, so keep casting.

Arcane Power on cooldown, together with Presence of Mind, your on-use trinkets and your damage racial if your race has one. It is 30% more damage for 15 seconds at 30% more mana a cast, off the global cooldown, so press it between casts. On a fresh pull, give the tank a Sunder or two first.

Presence of Mind on cooldown, and with Arcane Power once you have it. Your next spell is instant: spend it on your longest cast, Pyroblast once the raid build has it at 54 and Arcane Wrath before that and from 44 on the leveling build, and Frostbolt before 44 on the leveling build or while Arcane Wrath is on cooldown. Never spend it on an Arcane Blast that the global cooldown already caps at 1.5 seconds.
Pyroblast the moment Presence of Mind is up, from 54 on the raid build: a 6 second cast without Heating Up stacks goes out instant, the most cast time Presence of Mind can save you.

Arcane Wrath the moment Presence of Mind is up, from 44 with the leveling build and on the raid build before Pyroblast at 54, if it is off cooldown. At 3.5 seconds, 3.3 once Accelerant is in, it is your longest cast until Pyroblast, and the whole way on the leveling build, so the instant saves the most time.

Frostbolt the moment Presence of Mind is up before 44 with the leveling build, or while Arcane Wrath is on cooldown, so the cast goes out instant. Presence of Mind on a 1.5 second Arcane Blast saves nothing, since the global cooldown already holds you that long.

Arcane Missiles the moment Missile Barrage lights up. The proc makes it free, or 30% of its cost inside Arcane Power, halves the channel and fires a missile every half second. With both ranks Arcane Blast procs it 40% of the time and Arcane Wrath, Fireball and Frostbolt 20%, half that with one rank, so this is a big share of your damage. Rank 7 is the top trainer rank; rank 8 is a book from Ahn'Qiraj.

Arcane Missiles until you have both ranks of Missile Barrage, the second at 22 on the leveling order and at 24 on the raid order: on a long fight it does more damage for its mana than Arcane Blast once you have it and more damage a second than Frostbolt. Once both are in, Missiles waits for the free proc and Blast takes over.
Pyroblast on 3 Heating Up stacks, when it is a 1.5 second cast. On 1 or 2 stacks it is still too slow, so keep casting.

Fire Blast every time it is ready with the raid build, once Heating Up is in: every hit is a stack, a crit adds another, and Improved Fire Blast makes it a 6 second cooldown. On the way to 60 it only finishes a mob or fills a step on the move.
Arcane Wrath every time it is ready while you hold 3 Blast stacks, from 44 with the leveling build: the stacks' spell damage and 5% of your maximum mana both go into it.

Arcane Blast to 3 stacks. Past 3, keep blasting only while your mana bar is fuller than the share of the fight still to go, which you read off the boss's health bar, and you are above 20% mana. Each stack adds 12% of your Intellect as spell damage and raises the next Blast's cost by 100%. The buff lasts 18 seconds from the first Blast and does not refresh. A Clearcasting proc makes even a stacked Blast free.
Fireball fills in a raid once you stop blasting. The stacks' spell damage still applies to it, it procs Missile Barrage 20% of the time, and its crits feed Heating Up and Ignite.

Frostbolt in a raid only when you are too low on mana for a Fireball. It costs a quarter less than the Fireball you have before 60 and a third less than Fireball's top rank at 60, and still procs Missile Barrage 20% of the time, but it feeds no Ignite or Heating Up, so it only stretches the last of your mana.

Frostbolt as the filler once you stop blasting on the way to 60. The stacks' spell damage still applies to it and it costs a fraction of a stacked Blast, and once both ranks of Missile Barrage are in it procs a free Missiles 20% of the time. When the stacks fall off, the next Blast starts a cheap new set.
Shoot only when you are out of mana and waiting on a gem, a rune or Evocation. A wand shot holds you for the wand's full speed, so never weave it between spells.
